description: Components, classes and recipes that agents assemble into applications with clod, published on ClodHub.

repository.note: Each version's archive is a release asset of the package's source repository; ClodHub records its sha256 and links to it.

namespace_definition.note: One segment: a lower-case reverse domain name the publisher controls, such as com.clodhub, or io.github.<owner> for a GitHub user or organisation. At most 100 characters.

name_definition.note: 2 to 64 characters. A class name ends in -class and a recipe name in -recipe; a component name ends in neither.

version_definition.note: MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH, or MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH-preview.N for a preview. A class version has no preview.

note: No qualifiers or subpath are defined: package names and references in clod files carry neither.
